Is a £57,000 Chinese SUV more luxurious than a £200,000 Range Rover SV?!
Introducing the Li Auto L9 Livis! It’s an all-new luxurious SUV that is set to go on sale in the UK next year.
It’s packed full of tech and luxurious features, and it clearly has class leaders such as the Range Rover in its sights! The question is, does it have what it takes to go toe-to-toe with a brand as renowned as Range Rover?
To find out, Mat’s brought the two of them together to see just how they compare. So let’s take a closer look at the L9, starting with the design!
